business_problem: Artefact needed a secure way to help a major French bank analyze customer behavior and target segments more effectively than sharing anonymized raw data with professionals.
solution_summary: Artefact used IBM watsonx.ai to build a generative AI demonstrator for a major French bank that wanted to use customer data more effectively without exposing teams to low-value raw datasets. Artefact clustered the bank's anonymized customer data into target groups and represented those segments as AI personas that professionals could question through a chat-style interface about habits and preferences. The project was delivered end to end in IBM watsonx.ai studio, which Artefact says supported both back-end and front-end work with a small team and let it combine foundation-model capabilities with explainability and strong data protection controls. The resulting architecture treats watsonx.ai as both the model runtime and application studio for persona generation, querying and rapid iteration, making it possible to deploy a secure, user-friendly insight tool for finance-sector users in just one month.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.ai
solution_components.role: Provides the studio and model runtime used to build the persona-based application from back end to front end.

data_flow: Anonymized bank customer data is clustered into target groups, watsonx.ai generates persona-based avatars for those clusters, and professionals query the avatars through a chat interface to get explainable insight into habits and preferences.
business_outcome: Artefact delivered the demonstrator in one month, created a tool where clusters can be generated almost instantaneously, and opened the door to additional generative AI projects after strong interest from stakeholders.
architecture_clues: The application was built end to end in watsonx.ai studio by a small team.
The deployment emphasized explainability and personal-data protection for a finance use case.
The personas are generated from clustered customer data rather than from manually authored profiles.
